analyst.summary: Ramco Cements delivered solid profit growth for the last full year, but that improvement was driven mainly by higher prices rather than higher sales volumes, which actually declined in the most recent quarter with granular data due to weak regional demand. The South Indian cement market remains intensely competitive as larger rivals continue adding capacity, and at roughly 31.6 times earnings the stock already prices in continued margin strength that volume trends do not yet support. We would trim rather than hold.
